trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. Completing three hops is correct behaviour, not premature or incomplete termination.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: The system completed all three hops and returned 24 documents (7 from hop 1, 7 from hop 2, 10 from hop 3). The claim was about whether the bass guitarist from Arma Angelus and Spike Slawson are both Celtic punk rock musicians. The retrieved documents identified Tim McIlrath as the bass guitarist from Arma Angelus (associated with hardcore punk/Rise Against) and Spike Slawson as a punk rock musician with Celtic rock influences through some projects, but neither was explicitly classified as a Celtic punk rock musician.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed as specified: it performed three retrievals using generated queries and returned all 24 retrieved documents. The summarizer steps correctly analyzed the retrieved passages and identified that the claim could not be verified because neither Tim McIlrath nor Spike Slawson was explicitly classified as a Celtic punk rock musician in the retrieved documents. The query generator steps produced increasingly focused queries attempting to find evidence for the Celtic punk classification. All seven specified steps ran to completion. The system correctly did not emit a verdict (as specified), and returned the concatenated document list as required. The absence of supporting evidence in the corpus is an environmental limitation, not a failure of the pipeline.
